{{Quote|The compound contained unauthorized cybernetic surgery suites that were churning out vessels and cyborgs that have been slicing into Corporate Alliance data-stores. This potential revenue-threat has been neutralized.|Corporate Alliance Magistrate Passel Argente|<ref name="AllianceAttacks" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the '''slicer compound''' was used to supply and train industrial [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] agents by building them [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] and performing [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] surgeries on them, thus turning them into [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]]. The base was [[Raid on Yirt-4138-Grek-12|destroyed]] by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] when it was discovered that the compound had supplied an agent named [[Denlace Sachoore]], who had tried to steal Alliance data.
